plan.recency: Fixed three-season half-life, not full-training-selected half-life
plan.teams: Two fixed variants for each regression family, with and without one-hot team identity
plan.objective: OOF CAGR / max(daily maximum drawdown, 0.01); 5% weight grid plus equal thirds
plan.calibration: Each OOF season uses only earlier OOF seasons for temperature; 2019 seeds calibration and is excluded from selection for every candidate
plan.limits: Previously examined test season; previously developed fixed forest settings/features. Historical actual lineups and Bet365 odds, no fees. This is a two-season OOF selection experiment, not untouched prospective evidence.
